notes: Application fee is $75 for US citizens/permanent residents and $90 for non-US citizens.

app_fee.value: Application fee is $75 for US citizens and permanent residents, and $90 for non-US citizens.
app_fee.quote: United States citizens and those with permanent resident visa status: $75

fee_waiver.value: Rackham fee waivers available for US citizens and permanent residents who have demonstrated financial need.
fee_waiver.quote: At this time, Rackham application fee waivers are available for U.S. citizens and permanent residents who have demonstrated financial need.

gre_general.value: GRE general test scores are no longer included in the admissions process for Rackham doctoral programs.
gre_general.quote: GRE general test scores are no longer included in the admissions process for Rackham’s doctoral programs.

toefl_min.value: Minimum required TOEFL iBT score is 84.

ielts_min.value: Minimum required overall IELTS score is 6.5 Academic.

english_waiver.value: Exemption granted if applicant completed undergraduate degree where instruction is English only.
english_waiver.quote: You completed all of your undergraduate education and earned an undergraduate degree at an institution where the language of instruction is English only.
